logger.doc:name: Log Process Start
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { correlationId: vars.correlationId, idempotencyKey: vars.idempotencyKey, message: "Order creation started", customerId: vars.originalPayload.customerId }]

logger.doc:name: Log Process End
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { correlationId: vars.correlationId, orderId: payload.orderId, status: payload.status, message: "Order creation completed successfully" }]

on-error-propagate.doc:name: On Error Propagate - Custom Business Errors

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { code: vars.httpStatus default 500, message: error.errorType.identifier, description: error.description, dateTime: now() as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'"}, correlationId: vars.correlationId }

%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { id: payload.customer.id as String, name: payload.customer.name as String, status: payload.customer.status as String, isPartner: payload.customer.isPartner default false, email: payload.customer.email as String, phone: payload.customer.phone as String }

%dw 2.0 output application/json --- payload map (product) -> { productId: product.productId as String, name: product.name as String, unitPrice: product.unitPrice as Number, currency: product.currency as String, status: product.status as String, inventory: { availableQuantity: product.inventory.availableQuantity as Number, reservedQuantity: product.inventory.reservedQuantity as Number } }
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { orderId: payload.orderId, status: payload.status, totalAmount: payload.totalAmount, message: "Order created successfully" }
